title: Recognition ladders
description: The stages that may read a line of each script, cheapest first, per OCR mode (docs/20-languages.md, section 17.2). Built by scripts/rank_stages.py from stages.json; never edited by hand.

stages_sha256.description: sha256 of the stages.json the ladders were built from. The server refuses to start when it differs from the stages.json it loads.

device.description: The device every rung runs on (section 17.8, item 4).

basis.description: reader: the reader that found the line, alone (paddle mode). pinned: TrOCR re-reads every line whatever its script (trocr mode). route: the route in stages.json, kept while a stage's quality or cost is unmeasured. ranked: built from measured facts by the rules of section 17.2.

left_off.description: Stages that could read this script but are not on the ladder, and why.

unmeasured.description: Stages whose quality or cost for this script is not measured, so the ladder could not be ranked.
